module.purpose: This file completes booking confirmation by creating the calendar event, marking one or more bookings accepted, recording audit events, scheduling reminders and workflows, and notifying webhook subscribers.
module.summary: The confirmation pipeline coordinates calendar event creation, booking persistence, recurring-booking updates, meeting URL propagation, confirmation communications, workflow scheduling, no-show triggers, audit events, and webhook delivery. It derives organization and team context, applies email and platform settings, enriches event payloads with booking responses, and isolates downstream notification failures through tracing and error handling.
module.businessContext: This supports Cal.com appointment confirmation across calendars, reminders, workflows, audits, and integrations. Failure can leave bookings unconfirmed, meetings unscheduled, or participants and external systems uninformed.
functions: fireBookingAcceptedEvent (~L42-93): Records accepted booking audit events for single or bulk confirmations.
handleConfirmation (~L95-604): Confirms bookings, creates meetings, schedules workflows, and dispatches notifications and webhooks.
